comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose the composition of their 'All Other' operating loss and explicitly cite stock-based compensation expense as a primary driver. NVDA attributes the year-on-year decrease in its All Other operating loss to the absence of a $1.4 billion acquisition termination cost, partially offset by an $839 million increase in stock-based compensation. Similarly, AMD breaks down its All Other operating loss for both 2024 ($4.2 billion) and 2023 ($4.4 billion), identifying stock-based compensation expense of $1.4 billion as a consistent major component in both years, alongside amortization of acquisition-related intangibles.

sentences.text: All Other operating loss - The year-on-year decrease was due to the $1.4 billion Arm acquisition termination cost in fiscal year 2023, partially offset by a $839 million increase in stock-based compensation expense in fiscal year 2024.
All Other operating loss of $4.2 billion in 2024 primarily consisted of $2.4 billion of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and $1.4 billion of stock-based compensation expense.
All Other operating loss of $4.4 billion in 2023 primarily consisted of $2.8 billion of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and $1.4 billion of stock-based compensation expense.
